name: Sanctuary Tiger SEO
author: rachelmharrisoncoaching

sections.description:
Sanctuary Tiger SEO gives every page on your site the technical SEO foundation search engines and social platforms expect, configured once and working immediately after activation.

What’s included:

  • Document title tags, with safe fallback handling for themes that don’t declare title-tag support
  • Meta descriptions, with sensible fallbacks (excerpt, term description, author bio)
  • Canonical URLs on every page and post type
  • Robots meta — correct index/noindex handling on search, 404, and attachment pages automatically
  • Open Graph and Twitter Card tags
  • Core Schema.org structured data: Organization, Person, LocalBusiness, WebPage/WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Article, FAQPage, and Service entities
  • XML sitemaps
  • A database-backed 301/302 redirect manager, including wildcard matching and per-redirect hit counts
  • A one-click broken-internal-link scanner and cleanup tool
  • Real-time SEO health checks for thin content, missing titles, and duplicate meta descriptions
  • A visual robots.txt editor
  • Settings import/export

Optional Pro add-on

An optional Pro add-on is available separately (not through WordPress.org) for sites that want AI-assisted writing tools, advanced Schema types (Events, Courses, Products, Reviews, Video, Podcast), Core Web Vitals monitoring, multi-location SEO, programmatic page generation, Google Search Console rank tracking, and other advanced features. The free plugin works completely independently of it.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services under specific conditions:

WordPress AI Client (optional, Pro add-on only)

AI-powered features (Pro add-on only) are routed entirely through the WordPress AI Client (built into WordPress 7.0+). The site owner selects and configures their AI provider once at Settings → Connectors. Neither the free plugin nor the Pro add-on contacts any AI provider’s API directly — all requests go through the WordPress AI Client, using whichever provider the site owner has configured there.
* WordPress AI Client documentation: https://developer.wordpress.org/apis/ai-client/

Broken link checker & canonical conflict scanner

The SEO Health dashboard includes a broken internal link scanner and a canonical conflict checker. When you run a scan, the plugin sends HTTP requests to your own site — HEAD requests to URLs found in your own content, and GET requests to your own XML sitemap. These requests go only to your own domain and only to URLs that are already publicly visible on your site. No data is sent to any third party.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sanctuary-tiger, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new “Sanctuary Tiger” menu item to configure your site’s SEO settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an account, API key, or license to use?

No. Every feature listed above works immediately after activation with no signup, no API key, and no license key required.

Is this compatible with Yoast SEO or RankMath?

This plugin detects whether Yoast SEO or RankMath is active and automatically defers title and meta description output to them to avoid duplicate tags. Running more than one full SEO plugin at once is not recommended.

screenshots.caption: Live Google search preview with SEO title, meta description, and Open Graph fields — character counters included.
SERP previews across desktop, mobile, light and dark, plus Facebook and X/Twitter card previews, one-click schema validation, and the FAQ schema builder.
The module dashboard — every feature is a toggle, so the plugin only loads what you use.
The redirect manager — database-backed 301/302 redirects with wildcard matching and hit counts.
SEO Health — real-time checks for thin content, missing titles, duplicate meta descriptions, and broken internal links.
